items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ f $ of degree $ n $, this is a square matrix of size $ (2n - 2) \times (2n - 2) $ constructed from the Sylvester matrix of $ f' $ (the derivative of $ f $) and $ f $. items.informal_description: The Wronskian of two polynomials $ a $ and $ b $ is defined as $ a \cdot b' - a' \cdot b $, where $ b' $ and $ a' $ denote the formal derivatives of $ b $ and $ a $, respectively. This results in a polynomial in $ R[X] $.

items.informal_name: Wronskian Bilinear Form on Polynomial Rings

items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $, this bilinear form on the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ maps a pair of polynomials $ (f, g) $ to their Wronskian $ f'g - fg' $, where $ f' $ and $ g' $ denote the formal derivatives of $ f $ and $ g $, respectively. It is defined as the difference between the composition of left multiplication by the derivative and the flipped composition of derivative with left multiplication.

items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ a $ in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ over a commutative ring $ R $, the Wronskian of $ a $ with itself is zero, i.e., $ \operatorname{Wronskian}(a, a) = 0 $. items.informal_name: Jacobi matrix of a pre-submersive presentation
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {S : Type v} →
    {ι : Type w} →
      {σ : Type t} →
        [inst : CommRing R] →
          [inst_1 : CommRing S] →
            [inst_2 : Algebra R S] →
              (P : Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation R S ι σ) → [Fintype σ] → [DecidableEq σ] → Matrix σ σ P.Ring
items.informal_description: The Jacobi matrix associated with a pre-submersive presentation $ P $ is the matrix representation of the differential operator $ \partial_i $ acting on relations, expressed in the standard basis of functions $ \sigma \to P.\text{Ring} $. Its entries are the partial derivatives of the relations $ P.\text{relation}_j $ with respect to the generators $ P.\text{map}(i) $ in the polynomial ring $ R[\iota] $, arranged as a $ \sigma \times \sigma $ matrix over $ P.\text{Ring} $.

items.informal_description: For a matrix $ M $ with entries in a commutative semiring $ R $ and a row index $ i $, this function constructs the multivariate polynomial over $ R $ in variables indexed by $ n $, where each term is the entry $ M_{i,j} $ multiplied by the variable $ x_j $, summed over all columns $ j $. The polynomial is defined as $ \sum_j M_{i,j} x_j $, representing the $ i $-th row of the matrix as a linear combination of variables corresponding to its columns.

items.informal_name: Matrix Representation of Differential Equals Map Applied to Jacobi Matrix
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {ι : Type w} {σ : Type t} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (P : Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation R S ι σ) [inst_3 : Fintype σ] [inst_4 : DecidableEq σ],
  LinearMap.toMatrix' P.aevalDifferential = (MvPolynomial.aeval P.val).mapMatrix P.jacobiMatrix
items.informal_description: The matrix representation of the differential operator $ \text{aevalDifferential} $, obtained by evaluating partial derivatives of relations in the algebra presentation, is equal to the result of applying the evaluation-induced algebra homomorphism $ \text{aeval} $ to the Jacobi matrix $ \text{P.jacobiMatrix} $. This establishes an equality between two constructions: (1) converting the differential operator to a matrix directly, and (2) transforming the Jacobi matrix via the evaluation homomorphism.

  [inst_1 : Fintype ι] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (i j : ι),

items.informal_description: For a finite type $\iota$ with decidable equality, the $(i,j)$-entry of the Jacobi matrix of the naive pre-submersive presentation is equal to the partial derivative of the relation $v_j$ with respect to the generator $a_i$ in the polynomial ring $R[\sigma]$. This establishes that the matrix is formed by evaluating $\partial_{a_i}(v_j)$ for all indices $i,j : \iota$.

items.informal_name: Matrix Representation of Sylvester Map Equals Sylvester Matrix
items.type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] (f g : Polynomial R) (hf : f.natDegree ≤ m) (hg : g.natDegree ≤ n),
  (LinearMap.toMatrix ((Polynomial.degreeLT.basis R m).prod (Polynomial.degreeLT.basis R n))
        (Polynomial.degreeLT.basis R (m + n)))
      (f.sylvesterMap g hf hg) =
    (Matrix.reindex (Equiv.refl (Fin (m + n))) finSumFinEquiv.symm) (f.sylvester g m n)
items.informal_description: For polynomials $ f $ and $ g $ over a commutative ring $ R $ with $ \deg(f) \leq m $ and $ \deg(g) \leq n $, the matrix representation of the Sylvester map $ (p, q) \mapsto f \cdot q + g \cdot p $, expressed in the product basis of monomials $ \{1, X, \dots, X^{m-1}\} \times \{1, X, \dots, X^{n-1}\} $, equals the Sylvester matrix of $ f $ and $ g $ reindexed via the canonical equivalence $ \mathrm{Fin}(m) \sqcup \mathrm{Fin}(n) \simeq \mathrm{Fin}(m + n) $.
